basis: Reviewed immutable 5.1 ownership/relevance decisions, exact 47 participant boundaries, Runtime Time/Persistence value packages; no new role or owner decisions are inferred.
decision_policy: PERSISTENT_OWNER/PERSISTENT_CHECKPOINT -> INCLUDED; existing DERIVED_AND_VERIFIED -> DERIVED_AND_VERIFIED; existing NO/EXCLUDE -> EXCLUDED_NON_SEMANTIC; all other combinations fail closed.
ordering_policy: Owner CaptureSnapshot contracts sort keyed records by stable semantic IDs; logical queues preserve explicit sequence order; contributions sort by stable owner identity; strings and byte arrays carry explicit uint64 lengths; scalar integers are little-endian.
runtime_payload_policy: Runtime canonical v1 value codecs have no floating fields; application payloads are explicit schema-owned semantic input bytes, never native objects or ambient identity.
derived_policy: Foundation ID-generator scope/next and Society standings are included through their authoritative snapshots. Runtime projection/cache/handle state is recreated by fresh Runtime boot, then module-owned rebuild and reconciliation contracts; it is not copied as semantic identity.
